summary: Iteration 6 — tiny follow-up: quiet 'تمت المزامنة' toast after offline backlogs finish. Scope was code-review + backend regression + frontend smoke, matching the main-agent's stated 'keep tests light' guidance. CODE REVIEW offline.ts: (a) `onSyncComplete(cb)` properly exported, pushes cb into module-level `completeListeners` Set and returns an unsubscribe thunk (`() => completeListeners.delete(fn)`) — lines 64-69. (b) `syncQueue` declares `let syncedCount = 0` at the top of the flush (line 236) and increments ONLY on `o === 'ok'` (line 278); 'conflict' only bumps progress.done, not syncedCount; 'retry'/'offline'/'failed' never touch syncedCount — exactly as spec'd. (c) listeners fired exactly once at the very end of syncQueue (line 292, AFTER the `finally` resets syncing/progress) and ONLY when `syncedCount > 0`. CODE REVIEW SyncBanner.tsx: (a) `onSyncComplete` subscription lives in `useEffect(..., [])` with empty deps so it mounts once; the effect returns the unsub thunk directly (`return onSyncComplete(...)`) so React's cleanup unsubscribes on unmount — no leak. (b) `toastRef = useRef(toast)` + `toastRef.current = toast` on every render ensures the single long-lived subscription always calls the freshest useToast fn — no stale-closure risk. (c) Toast fires `تمت المزامنة · ${synced} عملية` and ONLY when `synced >= TOAST_THRESHOLD (=3)` — single-item + 2-item syncs stay silent as intended. REGRESSION offline.ts iteration-5 invariants intact: PARALLEL=6 (line 48), per-path serialization via `inFlightPaths` Set (lines 248-255), 409 → dropOptimistic + invalidateQueries + queue removal, no failed-tray entry (lines 202-207), 5xx/429/timeout classified transient with 1→16s jittered backoff and MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 (lines 149-150, 209-219), api.ts 25s AbortController untouched. The refactor to add syncedCount did not drop any outcome handling — all 5 outcomes ('ok'/'conflict'/'retry'/'offline'/'failed') still produce the correct queue mutation + progress update. FRONTEND SMOKE: login page (https://offline-sales-desk.preview.emergentagent.com) renders cleanly on 375x667 viewport with 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors, full Arabic 'النظام الذكي' hero + phone input + 'إرسال رمز التحقق' CTA visible. Authenticated SyncBanner/SyncSheet surfaces were exhaustively exercised in iteration 5 (1200-item backlog progress, failed-tray with إعادة/تجاهل pills, sync-sheet open on tap) and nothing in iteration 6 touched those paths — only a new listener was added. BACKEND: 8/8 passing on /api/auth/me × 4 seeded tokens (dev/owner/acct/agent all return 200 with correct role or employee_type) and /api/stats/overview + /api/products + /api/customers + /api/sales for OWNER (all 200). No deprecated expo packages detected in SyncBanner/offline.ts (uses react, react-native primitives + @react-native-community/netinfo).
critical_code_review_comments: offline.ts:66-69 — onSyncComplete contract is clean: Set-based registration, O(1) add/delete, unsub returns the Set.delete boolean (fine, callers ignore the return). Multiple subscribers supported (though SyncBanner only mounts once, this is future-proof).

offline.ts:236/278/292 — syncedCount semantics are exactly right. The distinction between syncedCount (ok only, drives the toast) and progress.done (ok + conflict, drives the banner %) is deliberate and correct: conflicts resolve to server state silently, no need to brag about them to the user.

offline.ts:292 — completeListeners.forEach is invoked AFTER the `finally` block resets syncing/progress, so if a subscriber calls useToast() → setState inside, we won't re-enter syncQueue in a bad state. Also fires exactly once per flush (outside the while loop), not per round.

SyncBanner.tsx:22-23 + 24-30 — toastRef pattern is the correct React idiom for 'subscribe once, always see latest fn'. If someone naively added `[toast]` to the deps array, they'd resubscribe on every render and double-fire the toast; the empty-deps + ref pattern avoids that. Worth preserving.
SyncBanner.tsx:10, 26 — TOAST_THRESHOLD=3 is a sensible floor; keeps single-sale catch-ups silent. If the threshold ever needs to vary by user role, lift to theme/config, but 3 is fine for v1.
Regression confirmed: offline.ts PARALLEL=6, inFlightPaths per-path order, 409 dropOptimistic+invalidate, 5xx backoff with MAX_ATTEMPTS=5, 25s abort via api.ts — all unchanged by this refactor.
